name: carousel-3d-motion
title: Carousel 3D (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A perspective carousel where cards rotate through depth, with drag and autoplay. Use it for portfolio and gallery sections that need presence.
docs: Motion build of `carousel-3d` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named exports: ThreeDCarousel, CarouselItem. `items` take { id, title, category, image, description? }. `autoPlay` with `autoPlayInterval` advances it; dragging pauses. Renders a plain , so it works outside Next.js.
